text:
Ellen: FYI we just had another onboarding flake in staging: duplicate deliveries after a brief 429 spike. Looks like probe traffic was forwarded into the same webhook path.
Ravi: Ugh. Is this the sampleapp prewarm again?
Ellen: Yep. It uses POST /deliver for prewarm and forwards it. Node and Python clients add Idempotency-Key so they're mostly fine; Go does not unless the user passes a key.
June: Parity gap + aggressive retry = duplicate side-effects. We should avoid relying on app authors to get this right.
ops-bot: [alert] 2026-04-01T09:12:31Z staging: /v1/deliver 429 surge detected, p95 retry-delay 310ms
Ravi: Quick fixes: 1) sampleapp change: use GET /health for prewarm and never forward, 2) SDK defaults: add best-effort advisory header so server can dedupe short-lived replays.
June: I sketched two ideas: "Retry-Token" (advisory token kept for ~3s) or opt-in header `X-Safe-Replay`. I slightly prefer Retry-Token since it signals advisory dedupe.
Ellen: Server-side we can implement an LRU cache keyed by token fingerprint -> response-id for a 2-3s window. Cheap and catches most doubled deliveries. Make it advisory: real Idempotency-Key has precedence.
Ravi: Also the retry algorithm needs to be standardized across SDKs. Current full-jitter with small base causes retry storms. Proposal: decorrelated-jitter, base=180ms, cap=1200ms, multiplier=2. Configurable in constructor.
June: Agreed. Let's add a `retry_config` option: {strategy: 'decorrelated', base_ms: 180, max_ms: 1200, safe_replay: 'off|advisory|strict'}. Docs will show recommended settings for onboarding.
Ellen: Minimal Node example for docs (inline):
```
// opt-in advisory token example
const token = makeRetryToken(JSON.stringify(payload), 'POST', '/v1/deliver', 'sampleapp-1');
fetch('/v1/deliver', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Retry-Token': token
  },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
});
```
Ravi: Good. Token should be non-reversible: HMAC(payload||method||path||instance-id||ts) truncated to avoid storing raw payload. Server only keeps token hashes and response pointers.
June: CI test idea: simulate transient 429 (first request 429, second 200) and assert sink sees one side-effect when Retry-Token present. Run for Node/Python/Go. Add test in onboarding pipeline.
ops-bot: [info] 2026-04-01T09:15:00Z created incident doc staging-429-duplicate-1
Ellen: Action items:
- Ellen: patch sampleapp to use GET /health for prewarm and add SAMPLEAPP_RETRY_TOKEN=true opt-in (PR 4332). Rolling to staging canary.
- Ravi: SDKs: add Retry-Token support + switch retry defaults to decorrelated-jitter; expose retry_config and safe_replay modes (PRs 4338/4339/4340).
- June: backend: LRU advisory dedupe prototype, metrics replay.advisory.hit/miss, safe by default in staging (PR 4345).
- CI-bot: add simulated 429 test in onboarding pipeline that asserts no duplicate side-effects when advisory token is used.
ci-bot: [note] will run test matrix across Node/Python/Go after SDK PR merges
Ravi: Small UX note: document when to use a persistent Idempotency-Key (payments, guaranteed dedupe) vs advisory Retry-Token (onboarding/prewarm/short-window dedupe).
June: Also add telemetry sampling to validate rollout: sample 1% of onboarding requests with token present and capture token fingerprint + outcome. Only in staging by default.
Ellen: Rolling PR 4332 to staging now (canary 10%). If duplicates persist we'll pause rollout. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [update] PR 4332 deployed to staging canary=10%, monitoring for 15m.
